1527415.steps:
1) Go to User/Settings page and click on the Accounting tab
2) Now under accounting tab you should see a check box for "Send RADIUS Accounting Information", Clicking the Send RADIUS Accounting information will then make the rest of the fields visible.
3) Under RADIUS Accounting Section click Add button to add new Radius Accounting Server, A Pop-up Server configuration dialog will apper
4) Enter the appropriate values for each field and click save.
5) Also verify that you can edit the New RADIUS Accounting Server entry successfully.
6) Now click on the delete button of the configured RADIUS Accounting Servers
1527415.initial: The deleted RADIUS Accounting Server should be deleted successfully and entry should not be displayed in the list, also we verify the entry is not present in TSR
1527415.title: Verify  Radius Accounting Server that is configured can be deleted successfully
1527415.result: The deleted RADIUS Accounting Server should be deleted successfully and entry should not be displayed in the list, also we verify the entry is not present in TSR
